technical.summary: ACN shows solid uptrend structure with multiple MA confirmations and momentum crossovers, but lacks strong trend conviction (low ADX), volume support, and SAR confirmation for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 79 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying (small amounts, non-senior members) 74 days old is stale; greed reading (69) suggests caution; neutral AAII sentiment and absent news data provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (101.88) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility; earnings 79 days out provides buffer but offers no offset to current risk environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with hull flip and stochastic bullish cross provides technical structure for mean-reversion entry near support (291.52) in an uptrend framework.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (VIX 101.88 crisis, inverted yield curve, CPI event in 1 day), volume is weak (0.49 ratio), ADX shows no trend conviction, and fundamental/sentiment scores are critically low with earnings risk 79 days out.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows price at support with hull flip and stochastic bullish cross, but macro environment is severely hostile with VIX at crisis levels (101.88) and inverted yield curve signaling recession risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis conditions (101.88) combined with inverted yield curve and CPI event in 1 day create extreme near-term volatility that overwhelms technical setup; earnings in 79 days add material downside risk with zero fundamental conviction.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position with 12 existing IT sector positions (19.7% of portfolio); concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure despite technical setup.
